settings.resetConfirm:
Reset autoresearch to defaults?

This discards the tuned retrieval parameters, the baseline score and phase progress learned by previous nightly runs, and clears the proposer, judge, window and auto-start settings.

Past experiment records are kept. This cannot be undone.
settings.resetDone: Autoresearch reset: tuned parameters, baseline and settings are back to defaults
settings.title: Settings
settings.intro: Auto-start hands the nightly window to Beat, which starts at most one run per night. Leave a model blank to use the active chat model. Each field saves when you leave it or press Enter.
settings.resetNote: Clears the tuned parameters, baseline and phase progress along with these settings. Past experiment records are kept.

revertDialog.body: This deactivates the currently active RAG config and re-activates the previously promoted one. With no predecessor, retrieval falls back to the legacy defaults.
